items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And we had a Smitty on drums. He was a crippled fellow.

ctx.x: Might be. A tall dark boy. And we had trombones... Let me see who was in the trombones. Eddie Durham and we had...I forget the other boys on trombone. I forget their name. And we had a Smitty on drums. He was a crippled fellow. Let me see... Who was playing piano? We had 17 pieces.
